cards.audioText: N: [Your call sign is CES209, you are approaching VYK, maintaining 4500m, squawking 3125, make an initial contact with Beijing Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你的呼号是东方209，你现在接近VYK，保持在4500米，应答机3125，与北京区调建立初始联系。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CES209, approaching VYK, maintaining 4500m, squawking3125.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，东方209，接近VYK，保持在4500米，应答机3125。

cards.audioText: C: CES209, Beijing Control, radar contact, direct to VYK, after passing VYK, climb to 8400m.
cards.audioTextZh: C：东方209，北京区调，雷达看见了，直飞VYK，过VYK后，上8400米。
cards.referenceText: Direct to VYK, after passing VYK, climb to 8400m, CES209.

cards.audioText: N: [Your weather radar observed thunderstorm ahead, request Beijing Control for right turn to avoid the thunderstorm.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你的气象雷达观察到前方有雷暴，向北京区调请求右转避开雷暴。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CES209, thunderstorm ahead on radar, request right turn to avoid it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，东方209，雷达显示前方有雷暴，请求右转避开。

cards.audioText: C: CES209, negative due military activity, turn right heading 010.
cards.audioTextZh: C：东方209，由于军事活动不可以，右转航向010。

cards.audioText: N: [Now there is a strong echo of thunderstorm, you are too close to the weather, request left turn to avoid it.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【雷暴有很强的回音，你距离雷暴太近，请求左转避让。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CES209, we are too close to thunderstorm, request left turn to avoid it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，东方209，我们离雷暴太近，请求左转避让。

cards.audioText: C: CES209, left turn is not permitted due restricted area.
cards.audioTextZh: C：东方209，由于限制区，禁止左转。

cards.audioText: N: [Suddenly, you have suffered from hail strike, your left windshield has cracked, report it to Beijing Control and request return to land.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【突然，你遇到了雹击，你左侧的风挡破裂，将情况报告给北京区调，请求着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CES209, hail strike and left windshield is cracked, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，东方209，雹击，左侧的风挡破裂，请求返场着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CES209, roger, turn right heading 340, direct to VYK, descend to and maintain 2400m.
cards.audioTextZh: C：东方209，收到，右转航向340，直飞VYK，下到2400米保持。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 340, direct to VYK, descend to and maintain 2400m, CES209.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向340，直飞VYK，下到2400米保持，东方209。

cards.audioText: C: CES209, descend to 2400m, contact Beijing Approach 119.25.
N: [Now you are maintaining 2400m, over VYK, you have got information K, contact Beijing Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你现在保持在2400米，过VYK，你收到通播K，联系北京进近。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CES209, maintaining 2400m over VYK, information K.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，东方209，保持2400米，过VYK，通播K。

cards.audioText: C: CES209, Beijing Approach, radar contact, follow VYK05 arrival, expect radar vectors for ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：东方209，北京进近，雷达看见了，按照VYK05进场，预计雷达引导盲降进近跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Follow VYK05 arrival, expect radar vectors for ILS approach runway 36R, CES209.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按照VYK05进场，预计雷达引导盲降进近跑道36右，东方209。

cards.audioText: N: [During approach, neither of you can see through the windshield due to cracked windshield, you ask Beijing Tower for auto land.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【进近过程中，由于风挡破裂，你们两都无法通过玻璃看到外面，向北京塔台请求自动着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CES209, neither of us can see through the windshield due to cracked windshield, request auto land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，东方209，由于风挡破裂，你们两都无法通过玻璃看到外面，请求自动着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CES209, runway 36R, cleared to land.
N: [After landing, you can't see the taxiway clearly due to cracked windshield, request a tug.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【着陆后，由于风挡破裂，你看不清滑行道，请求拖车。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CES209, unable to see taxiway clearly due cracked windshield, request a tug.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，东方209，由于风挡破裂，看不清滑行道，请求拖车。

cards.audioText: C: CES209, hold position, the tug will come soon.
cards.audioTextZh: C：东方209，原地等待，拖车马上来。
cards.referenceTextZh: 原地等待，收到，谢谢，东方209。
